 This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER 1] They are heard.
Perused the case-diary/challan papers.

2] MCRC No.24468/2024 and MCRC No.24351/2024 are first applications filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicants/accused, in connection with FIR/Crime No.359/2024, Date:- not mentioned registered at P.S. - Khategaon, District - Dewas (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 366, 343, 506 and 120-B of IPC.
3] The allegation against the applicants is that they were also involved in the present case wherein the main allegation of rape is against co-accused Balram.

4] Counsel for the applicants has submitted that the prosecutrix, who was aged about 21 years solemnized marriage with main accused Balram and copy of the marriage certificate is also placed on record along with photographs.

It is submitted that so far as the present applicants are concerned, they had only signed the papers as they were witnesses to the marriage and subsequently when the prosecutrix went back to her home, she has lodged the report also arraying the present applicants.
Case of present applicants is identical to the case of co-accused person Shubham, who has been granted anticipatory bail vide order dated 06.06.2024 passed by this Court in MCRC No.24230/2024.

is submitted that there are no criminal antecedents against the present applicants and if the applicants are arrested, an irreparable loss would be caused to their reputation despite the fact that they had no role to play in the aforesaid offence.
5] On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer but fairly submits that case of the present applicants is identical with the co-accused Shubham.

6] Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of case diary so also considering other facts and circumstances of the case and on the ground of parity with co-accused Shubham, this Court is of the view that applicants deserve to the enlarged on anticipatory bail hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the applications are allowed.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on merits of the case, the applications are allowed and it is directed that in the event of their arrest, applicants shall be released on bail, upon their executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) each and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
8 ] Applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
They shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
